name: DecryptedText-TS-TW
blurb: Text animates from encrypted gibberish to readable, triggered by hover, scroll, or click.
description: Renders text as scrambled characters and progressively reveals the readable text character by character or randomly. Trigger modes: hover, scroll visibility, or click; can reverse back to encrypted.
use_when: A reveal animation that wants to intrigue or disguise content until the user interacts.
avoid_when: When the content must be immediately readable for SEO or accessibility compliance.
a11y: Encrypted text is shown visually but hidden with aria-hidden; readable text is in sr-only for screen readers. Works correctly when decrypted.
